profiles.summary: A minimal module-boundary policy for new source without prescribing framework layers or creating product directories.
invariants: Place each new business capability in a named feature or domain module with a clear responsibility.
Keep module-specific code cohesive and expose cross-module use through an explicit public entrypoint.
Keep shared code independent of concrete business modules.
Do not use this policy to pre-create speculative layers, repositories, interfaces, event buses, or empty directories.
Do not use this policy as authorization to move, rewrite, or reformat existing code.
